# Albert Marni Joensen

Albert Marni Joensen is a senior physician (overlæge) with a PhD, based at [[regionshospitalet-nordjylland|Regionshospitalet Nordjylland]] in Hjørring [^src1] [^src2] [^src3]. He is a member of the co-chair leadership (formandsskabet) of the steering group for the [[databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark|Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark]] (AFDK), the Danish national quality registry for atrial fibrillation care [^src1] [^src2].

He appears consistently across the AFDK annual reports as part of the registry's governing leadership. In the AFDK 2023 annual report — covering the period 1 July 2022 to 30 June 2023, based on data from 19,671 incident and 134,810 prevalent atrial fibrillation patients — he is listed among the members of the formandsskab (co-chair board) responsible for the steering group's conclusions and recommendations on quality indicators such as anticoagulation treatment, echocardiography, TSH measurement, bleeding risk assessment, and patient education [^src1] [^src2]. This leadership group operated under the overall chairmanship of Lars Frost. He is listed again in the same role in the AFDK 2024 report (pages 66–70), which discusses patient representatives' perspectives on structured patient education, describes how Hospitalsenhed Midt has implemented systematic patient education since 2012, and reaffirms the steering group's composition and the database's methodological limitations [^src3]. AFDK operates as a nationwide quality database under the Dansk Cardiologisk Selskab and with approval from Sundhedsstyrelsen [^src3].
